Shell scripting (Bash used only for systemd/admin)
Zephyr, JTAG/SWD counted adjacent via FreeRTOS/STM32 but nothing demonstrates them
IMU (single ADXL345 accelerometer, not a fused IMU)
understated_by_keywords: Planctech wearable glove + MR headset concept is real XR/wearable sensor-hub-adjacent evidence
Turret Jetson-to-STM32 UART command path is a small-scale MCU-to-application-processor link
